data.content: {"findings":[{"kind":"contrast","heuristic":8,"severity":3,"element":"Introductory paragraph (\"Choose when we deliver your orders...\")","summary":"The light grey body copy under \"Delivery preferences\" has insufficient contrast against the white card background, falling below the WCAG 2.2 AA 4.5:1 minimum for body text.","fix":"Reuse the existing dark text colour already applied to the \"Delivery preferences\" heading, \"Delivery window\" label, and select value instead of the light grey text colour."},{"kind":"target-size","heuristic":7,"severity":2,"element":"\"?\" button next to \"Save preferences\"","summary":"The square \"?\" control is visibly smaller in both width and height than the adjacent \"Save preferences\" button and falls below the 44 x 44 CSS px touch-target floor.","fix":"Size the \"?\" button's width and height to match the existing control height already used by the adjacent \"Save preferences\" button and \"Delivery window\" select."}],"nielsen":[0,0,0,0,0,0,2,3,0,0],"personas":[{"persona":"keyboard-only","blocked":false,"note":"At rest, the form presents standard interactive controls (select, primary button, and help button); keyboard traversal and focus rings are not visible without interaction."},{"persona":"screen-reader","blocked":false,"note":"Visual structure shows a clear heading, field label, select, and submit button; programmatic labels and accessibility tree state are not visible in the screenshot alone."},{"persona":"low-vision","blocked":false,"note":"The heading, field label, dropdown, and \"Save preferences\" button have strong contrast, so the task is completable, but the grey explanatory text has low contrast and the \"?\" button is undersized."},{"persona":"first-time","blocked":false,"note":"Selecting a delivery window and saving preferences is straightforward, though the low-contrast depot retention policy note is harder to notice and the small \"?\" button is harder to hit."}],"rebuild":false}
